signal: Akkio partnered with LiveRamp in April 2026 to enable AI-driven measurement and insights for marketers, building on its $15M Series A

email.body1:
Darcey, saw Akkio partnered with LiveRamp to bring AI-driven measurement to marketers, building on the Series A.

A partnership that opens a new channel usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Akkio off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Darcey, quick follow-up for Akkio.

As CRO, you know the number climbs faster than headcount can, and a new partner channel only widens the gap. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the shortfall surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Akkio needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Darcey, last bit of proof for Akkio.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Akkio's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Darcey, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a new partner channel is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-A motion? I'll tailor it to Akkio either way.
